blocks.text:
To: James Garcia
Cc: Michelle Banks

With the engagement letter signed, I want to open our working thread for the reinsurance pricing review. Keep your replies on this chain and we will do the same, so the whole record of what we asked for and when sits in one place. This is the practical start of the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} review, and the first stretch is about getting your data in and reconciled before we measure anything.

To get moving, we need the treaty documents for the ceded program and the cession, premium, and loss data behind them. Michelle Banks will send you a short, specific request this week, listing the exact files and the format we would like them in. We would rather ask for exactly what we need than hand you a long generic checklist, so the request will be narrow. If you can point us to whoever on your side pulls the reinsurance accounting, we will take the detail up with them directly and keep your team at Gonzalez, Campbell and Kelly out of a long back-and-forth.

There is no urgency this week; a first read on what is readily available is enough to get us started. If anything we ask for is easier to send in a different form than we requested, tell Michelle and we will adapt to how your systems export it. Once the files are in, I will confirm receipt and let you know what reconciles cleanly and where we will need to follow up. Thank you, and we are glad to be doing this work.
